detail.longDescription: I have never felt or believed in Dooms day theories about AI. But below is one of only 2 occasions where I am feeling AI can be too dangerous. While building world model for enterprise decisions, I am intrigued by how far the AI can go out of reach. Got to know - that now world models can learn from emotions & genetics. That means - actually predicting the outcome & behavior of humans. If going unabated - so the builder can bring in bias. It sounds Deja vu for when the racist theories developed in wraps of the scholarly research in 1900s. When I understand how the world model is gonna work - practically emotions & genetics aren't very far away from being built. There are already startups working on it. While ours is only for Enterprise decisions, the one on genetics as world-wide population scale impact. For World Models for Physical AI or Humanoids - this is more of physical tasks. I don't call it dangerous as there are quite a few checks & controls. But when world models are used for Genetics - this has far reaching unabated repercussions on how humans bheave with each other. As models become more powerful, ppl will start relying on it. I am not sure how the alignment of World Models will happen? LLMs are tbh primitive in nature. For World Models alignment - are there any specific efforts or initiatives wroking on it? We would be glad to include any alignment frameworks in our Benchmarking for Enterprise decisions. To monitor & remove bias.
